expectations.text: Output contains all three top-level headings: '# Session Title', '# Timeline', and '# Final Conclusion'
expectations.evidence: Has H1 '# Claude Code Session Export'. Missing '# Timeline'. Missing '# Final Conclusion' — uses '## Outcome' and '## Conversation' structure instead.

expectations.text: Each round in Timeline has all four sub-headings: '### 用户', '### AI', '### 执行', '### 结果'
expectations.evidence: Uses '### Round N — Topic' headings with '**User:**' / '**Claude:**' / '**Finding:**' / '**Result:**' bold labels — no Chinese subsection headings at all.

expectations.text: SQL query (SELECT * FROM orders...) and CREATE INDEX statement appear inside fenced code blocks
expectations.evidence: Lines 16-20: SELECT query in ```sql block. Lines 38-40: CREATE INDEX in ```sql block. \d orders also in ```sql block.

expectations.text: '# Final Conclusion' contains all four sub-sections: '## 问题本质', '## 关键结论', '## 最终方案', '## 后续动作'

eval_feedback.overall: Baseline consistently fails on structure. SQL code-block assertion passes for both — confirms it's the weakest discriminator.
